fullPassage: Claude Shannon was an American mathematician and information scientist, famous for being the "father of information theory." As a child, he was interested in electrical devices and built a telegraph that connected to his friend's home half a mile away. At age 21, he started his master's program in electrical engineering. His master's thesis on digital computing theory has been called the "most important master's thesis of all time." During World War II, he worked to help win the war by inventing a machine that helped destroy German rockets. In 1950, with the help of his wife, he built a machine capable of learning by itself. This machine was viewed as part of the foundation of Artificial Intelligence. In 1958, he became a full professor at MIT and continued to teach there for more than 20 years. A biography written about his life called him, the "most important genius you've never heard of."

Shannon은 석사 과정에서 전기 공학을 전공했다.
Shannon이 만든 학습 기계는 인공지능의 기초로 여겨졌다.

questions.passage: Claude Shannon was an American mathematician and information scientist, famous for being the "father of information theory." As a child, he was interested in __________ devices and built a telegraph that connected to his friend's home half a mile away. At age 21, he started his master's program in electrical engineering. His master's thesis on digital computing theory has been called the "most important master's thesis of all time." During World War II, he worked to help win the war by inventing a machine that helped destroy German rockets. In 1950, with the help of his wife, he built a machine capable of learning by itself. This machine was viewed as part of the foundation of Artificial Intelligence. In 1958, he became a full professor at MIT and continued to teach there for more than 20 years. A biography written about his life called him, the "most important genius you've never heard of."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 electrical: 'interested in _____ devices'에서 전기 장치라는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① digital — 본문 단어이나 'digital devices'는 어린 시절 맥락과 불일치
✅ ② electrical — 'interested in _____ devices and built a telegraph'. 전기 장치에 관심 ←정답
❌ ③ computing — 본문 단어이나 'computing devices'는 맥락과 부자연스러움
❌ ④ important — 'important devices'는 문맥과 관련성 약함
det.tip: electrical devices — 전기 장치. 전신기 제작과 연결
